_comment: Every tool that declares reach anyone, with the reason it is safe: the in-code guard it relies on (callers list, presence proof, own-scope check, held at the Gate), or read-only. A tool with a mutating verb in its name needs a reason that names a guard; read-only does not count. PENDING reasons are tracked and shrink. test/reach-anyone.test.js fails on an anyone with no entry.
